tags.picture_matters: The text layer detaches every minus sign from its number ('- 0.64', '- 0.06', '- 0.14', '- 0.45'), so a reader that splits on spaces reads +0.64 and a stray '-'. It also moves the Asset Only endline SEs (2.48) (2.01) (0.91) (0.055) onto the line with the follow-up N (1482 ...), and puts the follow-up SEs above them. The sign and the SE pairing must be taken from the picture, where '-0.64' is printed as one token directly above '(2.48)'.

context_needed: Ghana Graduation from Ultra Poverty evaluation (Banerjee and Karlan). 'Any GUP' pools the GUP sub-arms with and without the savings component; 'Asset Only' households received goats with no coaching or support, compared with their own control group (PDF pp. 13-14, design chart PDF p. 25). Results are ITT (PDF p. 35, text above the table). Endline was conducted immediately after the two-year programme and the follow-up about one year later (PDF p. 8). Units: 2014 PPP US$ per capita per month.

rule: A minus sign separated from its number in the text layer ('- 0.64') still belongs to it: take the sign from the picture and store -0.64. Each arm panel and each round block gives its own rows; the panel label sets the arm and the Endline/Followup header sets the time point.
